verdict.rationale: Dagster's evidence pack covers ingestion integrations (Fivetran, Airbyte, dlt) and general orchestration/asset features, but there is no documented reverse-ETL/activation capability for pushing modeled warehouse data back into CRM, ads, or support SaaS tools. Community commentary even notes Dagster lacks the breadth of integrations (e.g., Hightouch) that Airflow has for such use cases.
